notes._note: CRI single-node scaleup policy (copy engine + chunking), generated by gen_policy_from_table.py from /home/xi/results/best_cvars_no_pacing.md. Chooses the copy-engine or compute-kernel path per collective, rank count and message size, plus the kernel cvars measured for that band. The engine ignores everything under notes.

vocabulary.copy_path=copy_engine: Copy-engine path for this call: the kernels see CCL_SYCL_COPY_ENGINE=1 (alltoall: CCL_SYCL_ALLTOALL_COPY_ENGINE=1).
vocabulary.copy_path=kernel: Compute-kernel path for this call: the copy-engine switch reads 0. reduce_scatter at 2 ranks still moves data with memcpy once the per-rank chunk reaches 4 segments (built-in rule, also active when the table was measured).
vocabulary.simple_ring_segment_size=<bytes>: Per-call CCL_SYCL_<COLL>_SIMPLE_RING_SEGMENT_SIZE. Replaces the table's CCL_SYCL_TMP_BUF_SIZE: segment = CCL_SYCL_TMP_BUF_SIZE / depth, depth = max(ranks,3) for allreduce/reduce_scatter, ranks for allgather. The allocation stays at the default, which is large enough for every segment here.
vocabulary.simple_chunk_size=<bytes>: Per-call CCL_SYCL_<COLL>_SIMPLE_CHUNK_SIZE, value copied from the table.
vocabulary.global_config.<coll>_self_copy_threshold: Process-wide, not per band: CCL_SYCL_<COLL>_SELF_COPY_THRESHOLD for allgatherv, alltoall and alltoallv when that cvar is not set in the environment. Own-block bytes from which the copy-engine self copy runs on the second copy engine; 0 keeps it on the stream queue. Measured on NEO 26.40 at 2 and 4 ranks: the parallel self copy never loses and pays off from about 8M per rank, so the value does not depend on comm size or message size and is kept at the library default of 8M here.
vocabulary.algorithm=default: Guard leaf below the smallest measured size (16M total): no override, env defaults decide.

notes._note_msg_size: msg_size is PER-RANK bytes = count * dtype_size. The table Size column is the whole buffer, so allreduce msg_size = Size and reduce_scatter / allgather / alltoall msg_size = Size / comm_size.
notes._note_bands: Siblings are evaluated in order, first match wins: 'msg_size<=N' means above the previous bound and <= N; 'msg_size=any' covers everything above the largest measured size (1G total).
notes._note_comm_size: Only comm_size 2, 4 and 8 were measured; other sizes have no branch, so the legacy dispatcher decides.
notes._note_inplace: No in-place filter in the schema. Where the in-place and out-of-place rows disagree, the option with the smaller worst-case busbw loss was chosen; between two kernel options, the one with the larger margin over the copy engine. See _conflicts.
notes._note_copy_engine: copy_engine maps to CCL_SYCL_COPY_ENGINE (SYCL memcpy). If the table's CE numbers came from the Level Zero copy-engine lists (CCL_ENABLE_ZE_CE), the copy-engine bands may not reach them.
notes._adjustments: Bands switched to algorithm=default (no override, library defaults) after measuring the policy against the defaults on NEO 26.40 (/home/xi/results/perf_nopacing_neo26.40_20261007_0440, 2 and 4 ranks): a band is switched when the policy is slower by more than 2 GB/s in out-of-place or in-place and not faster in the other. Switched: reduce_scatter 2r 8M per rank (policy 40.8/40.9 vs default 44.0/46.0 GB/s); alltoall 2r 16M per rank and up (policy 32-44/41-46 vs default 40-49/42-49). Not switched: alltoall 4r 4M per rank (single-sweep outlier; three repeats favour the policy) and alltoall 4r 8M-16M per rank (the policy runs the same copy-engine configuration as the defaults). Also switched, by an A/B test on GPUs 0,1 (/home/xi/results/allgather_2r_ce_test_20261007_0824, two rounds): allgather 2r above 64M per rank to copy_engine without a chunk (47.0/55.9 GB/s vs 33.1/52.6 for kernel + 16M chunk; copy engine + 16M chunk gave 47.0/54.8). Regenerating this file with gen_policy_from_table.py drops these adjustments.

collective=allreduce._note: msg_size == benchmark Size (allreduce count is the full buffer).

comm_size=2._adjusted: 8M per rank (16M total): library defaults, measured faster than the table's copy engine on NEO 26.40

collective=allgather._note: Also serves allgatherv (resolve(ctype) maps it here). msg_size == Size / comm_size (per-rank send count).

comm_size=2._adjusted: above 64M per rank (256M total and up): copy engine instead of the table's kernel + 16M chunk, measured faster in both columns on NEO 26.40
16M per rank (32M total) and up: library defaults (copy engine), measured faster than the table's kernel + 8M chunk on NEO 26.40
